text:
incident-bot: ALERT: Quietwave metering anomaly detected in eu-west1 — token counts delayed and shadow counts rising, overage flags spiked (~+18%). Trace-id: mw-1712345987. Paging on-call.

oncall-maya: ack — I'm on it, grabbing logs and metrics.

sre-jamie: joining. Which consumer/pipeline is showing lag?

oncall-maya: metering-emitter -> kafka (metering-eu1). consumer lag ~1500 msgs on partitions 2/3. Observed a window flush delay around 2024-04-22T04:33Z.

billing-ops-oliver: FYI support reports overage alerts already sent to a handful of customers between 04:35-04:45Z. Might be false positives.

support-lina: opened ticket for acme-corp (#T1234) — they saw an overage email at 04:38 and pinged support.

oncall-maya: initial plan: throttle emitter to stop amplification, then run reconcile. Will attempt a soft throttle first.

sre-jamie: before throttling, confirm duplication vs delayed ack. Quick check: `select count(1) from token_events where region='eu-west1' and ts > '2024-04-22T04:20Z'`

oncall-maya: ran that query — raw emitter shows ~1.16x events vs deduped ledger for the 04:30-04:50 window. Looks like retry amplification after a downstream partition bounce.

billing-ops-oliver: list of top affected accounts from quick scan: acme-corp (~+12k extra tokens), beta-studios (~+9k), three small accounts (~1-3k each). Recommend suppressing billing flags until we reconcile.

support-lina: drafting customer comms now: "We're investigating an internal metering issue that may have triggered incorrect overage notifications. We're pausing billing for impacted accounts while we reconcile." Will post draft for review.

oncall-maya: applying soft throttle: `kubectl -n infra set env deploy/emitter-emux EMITTER_RATE=500` — applying now.

sre-jamie: note — don't pause notifier service yet. If we mute notifier and counts later show undercount, we could miss real overages. Instead set notifier into 'suppress-duplicates' mode if available.

oncall-maya: good point. switching notifier to duplicate-suppress: `PATCH /config/overage-notifier {"mode":"suppress-duplicates"}` — done.

billing-ops-oliver: I'll tag affected accounts and set billing.suppress=true for those until reconciliation completes.

oncall-maya: starting reconcile dry-run: `./tools/reconcile_tokens --from 2024-04-22T04:30Z --to 2024-04-22T05:00Z --dry-run --region eu-west1`

sre-jamie: dry-run results: approx 16% duplicate delta, matches alert. After dry-run we can run the actual reconcile (non-dry). ETA ~45m for full run.

product-ryan: customer impact — any invoices already sent that need reversal?

billing-ops-oliver: invoices scheduled at 05:00Z for some customers — I'll pause invoice dispatch for the affected cohort and mark them as "pending reconciliation". Legal looped in if we need credits.

support-lina: sent interim "investigating" email to acme-corp and beta-studios, linked ticket #T1234 and #T1235, cc ops.

oncall-maya: monitoring dashboards: token emission rate trending down after throttle; consumer lag decreasing. Will keep watch and update every 15m. :white_check_mark:

incident-bot: NOTE: Pager rotation handoff acknowledged to @oncall-maya at 1712345995.

billing-ops-oliver: once reconcile completes, we'll produce an adjustments report and notify finance for invoice corrections. I'll also create an incident follow-up doc.

product-ryan: thanks — keep comms tight. If reconcile shows >$X for any single customer, escalate to exec comms.

support-lina: updated tickets and customers notified.

oncall-maya: mitigation looks stable for now. Reconcile proceeding (non-dry) in ~10m. I'll update thread after completion or sooner if anything changes.

sre-jamie: logging steps for postmortem: root cause hypothesis = emitter retry storm after partition bounce + delayed dedupe in ingestion. We'll capture logs + consumer offsets for RCA.

oncall-maya: update at 1712346060: reconcile complete (applied) — duplicates removed, affected accounts adjusted. Billing flags suppressed during window; invoices held and rescheduled. Postmortem artifact: https://redwood-internal/pm/INC-1712345987 (will populate). :heavy_check_mark:
